scope: 10 existing main portraits, no image transformation or edits

method.reviewMode: one reviewer, visual review of GitHub Actions in-memory crops of *existing* image bytes, fixed (unshifted) 10px coordinate grid
method.coordinates: source pixel coordinate origin upper-left; no per-image CSS correction
method.eyeDefinition: candidate midpoint of visible eye aperture/outline, judged from upper eyelid, lower rim and corners; NOT iris color centroid, geometric ambiguity from hair/eyelashes
method.chinDefinition: candidate lowest visible jaw contour at chin turn, not mouth

uncertainty.eyesPerAxisPx: approximately ±8–12 each based on 10px grid and occluded contour; epistemic, not certified 95% confidence interval
uncertainty.eyeSeparationPx: at least ±15–20 from combined eye-point uncertainty; sub-10px separation differences cannot be reliably classified
uncertainty.repeatability: NO independent second reviewer; no 2nd blind annotation

method.externalCheck: Previous audit image color-centroid changes were reviewed for consistency but are not the definition of the eye outline center.

previousSpecAnchors.note: Earlier specification used visually approximated markers; direct 10px-grid review gives different right-eye midpoint (~16px), so DO NOT overwrite official candidates or claim calibrated without independent review.

newMasterCandidate.status: unconfirmed, conflicts with prior uncalibrated candidate

rows.confidence: manual-grid single-reviewer estimate ONLY, NOT certified/independent duplicate measurement
rows.requiredFollowup: independent 2nd reviewer mark upper/lower visible eye outline and both canthi, chin tip and eye-center definition; compare disagreement

interpretation: Gym thinking, surprised, playful show strong downward candidate eye midpoint shifts (about +14 to +22px in Y) compared to gym smile; chin may move inconsistently across poses/expressions.
Private portraits are closer, but private surprised has a candidate ~11px upward eye-midpoint change.
The measured eye-to-eye distance does NOT establish perspective/scale changes below uncertainty bounds.
Every image remains unverified: image size/alpha pass does NOT make pose and landmark matching pass.
verdict: NO PASS issued for any portrait; human certified review and Android visual test pending
